description:
FOUND s495e (task #2099; everyday/modules/File-Compare-Copy.pl produced NO output at all and
an SBCL backtrace; perl prints "1 0 1 1 moved 501").

THE EMISSION IS THE EVIDENCE.  In the cached transpile of core File/Copy.pm
(~/.pcl-cache/modules/<hash>.lisp, `p-sub pl-copy`) the SAME label is lowered two ways:

    line 303:  (progn (p-or (p-open $from_h "<" $from) (go :fail_open1))     <-- BARE go
    line 322:  (catch :pcl-goto-fail_open1
    line 372:    (p-|| (p-close $from_h) (throw :pcl-goto-fail_open1 nil)))  <-- the machinery

File/Copy.pm's `copy` has `open $from_h, "<", $from or goto fail_open1;` at line 148 and the
label `fail_open1:` at line 204; the `catch` wrapper the compiler opens for the forward goto
starts LATER in the sub than the first `goto`, so that first one is outside it.  SBCL reports
it at compile time on every run ("in: p-sub pl-copy ... (GO :FAIL_OPEN1) ... attempt to GO to
nonexistent tag") and, when the branch is reached, the program dies with
sb-int:compiled-program-error and a Lisp backtrace -- not a perl-shaped die (#2108's family).

WHAT DID **NOT** REPRODUCE (do not retry these; all identical to perl, scratch/s495e/):
    p-goto.pl    `goto fail if !$x;` at statement level, label later in the sub
    p-goto2.pl   `$r || goto fail if $doit;`  (the `||` + statement-modifier spelling)
    p-goto3.pl   `$ok or goto fail` and `$ok || goto fail` inside an if/else
    p-misc.pl 'copy'   File::Copy::copy() of a small file -- SUCCEEDS (the bad form is only
                 SIGNALLED when its branch executes; the compile warning is always there)
    p-fcc2/3/4.pl  import spelling, file size, the lexical being named $a, `use File::Compare`
THE REPRODUCER THAT WORKS is everyday/modules/File-Compare-Copy.pl itself (checked in), and
scratch/s495e/p-fcc.pl with `$| = 1` shows it dies inside the first `copy()`.
NOTE for whoever picks this up: without `$| = 1` the program prints NOTHING, because an
abnormal SBCL exit loses the buffered stdout -- that is why the instrument reports the first
difference at line 1.

ACCEPTANCE: no `(go :` for a perl `goto LABEL` anywhere in an emission (grep the corpus);
everyday/modules/File-Compare-Copy.pl becomes `same`; a guard row in Pl/t for the shape.


=== DONE (s500a, Opus, 2026-09-30) ===
TWO causes, both fixed; everyday/modules/File-Compare-Copy is `same` (perl `1 0 1 1 moved 501`).
(1) THE BARE (go): core File::Copy's `copy` declares `my $from_h;` / `my $to_h;` between its gotos and its labels (fail_inner / fail_open2 / fail_open1).  Pl/Parser2.pm's #252 GENERAL forward-goto wrap declined whenever any declaration preceded the last label, so `my $from_h` nested the remainder and the catches opened one `my`-level down -- AFTER the first `open … or goto fail_open1`, which lowered to a bare (go :fail_open1).  Fix: the #252 wrap HOISTS the declarations when they are all in the #126 subset (single scalar `my`, no local/modifier/self-init/redecl/promoted cell) -- ONE selector `_goto_hoist_decls`, shared with the #126 single-label hoist (was inline there).  The selector also refuses a name an EARLIER statement of the region reads: that read is perl's OUTER variable and the hoisted binding shadowed it -- a pre-existing silent wrong in #126 itself (`our $q = "outer"; sub s4 { my $r = "$q"; … goto E; my $q = "inner"; … }` printed "" where perl prints "outer"; probe goto14.pl).  File::Copy's emission now has no `(go :` at all.
(2) THE EMPTY FILE: the row writes `my $a = "/tmp/…"; open(my $o, ">", $a)`.  `my $a` is an exception-partition name and is renamed `$a__excl__0`, but `_is_lexical_decl_name` called the `$a` in `open(my $o, ">", $a)` a DECLARATION (PPI wraps that paren list in a Statement::Variable with no `=`; the #593 bug's third copy), so the read stayed on the special `$a` = "" and the file went nowhere.  Fix: `_is_lexical_decl_name` asks `_declarator_syms` (rule 11).
PROBES (perl -> 1bae682b/558cc5a0 extraction -> tree): scratch/s500a/probes/goto11-15.pl, mya.pl, fcc.pl, fcc2.pl -- goto11 base CRASH (attempt to GO to nonexistent tag) tree = perl; goto13 (crossing gotos + decls) base "forward goto to a standalone label" refusal, tree = perl; goto14 base silent "" tree = perl; mya base e1=0 tree = perl.
GUARDS: Pl/t/goto-label-01.t rows 10-13 (all four fail on base: row 11 dies the whole file there).
CORPUS: no emission change over perl-tests/lib/shapes from this member (corpus-diff lists only #2533's prototype facts); gate-SET scan 638 files identical.
subject: CRASH, not a perl die (core File::Copy): a forward `goto LABEL` that stands BEFORE the statement where the compiler opens the `catch :pcl-goto-LABEL` wrapper lowers to a BARE `(go :tag)` with no tagbody tag -- SBCL warns at every compile and kills the program with "attempt to GO to nonexistent tag" plus a backtrace
